title: The Hereditary Prince (Berlin) to Prince Frederik, 12 March 1796 (KHA Prins Willem V inv. 337; DECODE R2239, siblings R2236, R2237)

steps.what: Fetched R2236, R2237, R2239 metadata and 14 images with the session cookie.
de Leeuw 2001 (Cryptologia) found cited on the records; paywalled, not read.
R2237 pp. 2-4 are the decipherment of its cipher pp. 5-7; group rules (whole, positions, drop-first k, drop-last k) worked out from aligned examples.
Automatic split of plaintext lines among groups by depth-first search: too loose (whole-word groups absorb anything), abandoned.
Hand alignment of R2237 groups to its decipherment: about 110 entries rebuilt with no conflicts.
R2239 transcribed in groups (769 cipher groups).
R2237 table applied to R2239: 59% of groups.
Entries completed from alphabetical runs and R2239 context (paris, des, sans, londres, milord, elgin, haugwitz, comte, votre, reputation, republique, garanties): 70% of groups.
Huygens retroboeken search of Colenbrander's Gedenkstukken II for 'Elgin': R2239's body printed as no. 752 (to Prince Frederik), opening omitted.
Printed body aligned to the groups: fixes entries 208, 203, 209, 219, 159, 115, 202, 79, 36, 40, 95, 176, 29, 19, 114, 87.
Opening paragraph (not in print) read with the completed entries: conference of the 8th between Haugwitz and Elgin, Haugwitz at the King's ball; entry 244 once, unresolved.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The word list was rebuilt by aligning R2237's cipher pages with the contemporary decipherment on its pp. 2-4 (same KHA inv. 337 file), which read 59% of R2239 (70% with context); Colenbrander's Gedenkstukken II no. 752 (1906), found during the attempt, was then used as a crib for the body, and the completed entries read the opening that is not in print.
outcome.notes: R2239 read in full except one word (entry 244); 70% of groups read before the print was found; body agrees with Colenbrander no. 752. R2236 not read.

prior.where: Colenbrander, Gedenkstukken der algemeene geschiedenis van Nederland II (1906), no. 752, prints the body from the Huisarchief; the opening paragraph is not printed
